<h1>Sebastian</h1>

<p><strong>An AI agent in your calls.</strong></p>

<p>Sebastian joins your <img src="docs/assets/icons/whatsapp.svg" width="24" height="24" align="top" alt=""> WhatsApp and phone calls from your own <img src="docs/assets/icons/android.svg" width="24" height="24" align="top" alt=""> Android phone.<br>
Say its name mid-call and Sebastian answers out loud, looks things up, and takes action.</p>

## <img src="docs/assets/icons/workflow.svg" width="30" height="30" align="top" alt=""> How it works

1. **Sebastian joins the call.** Start a call as usual, or say "Hey Sebastian, call Shahwaiz". Sebastian is on the line with you, with no second number or extra device, and the other person doesn't need to install anything.
2. **Sebastian listens.** Sebastian tells everyone it's there, then stays quiet and follows both sides of the conversation.
3. **Say its name and Sebastian acts.** Sebastian answers out loud so both of you hear it, and does the work while the call is still going.
4. **Hang up and it's written down.** A summary with decisions and action items comes to your <img src="docs/assets/icons/whatsapp.svg" width="24" height="24" align="top" alt=""> WhatsApp, and the full notes go to <img src="docs/assets/icons/notion.svg" width="24" height="24" align="top" alt=""> Notion.

## <img src="docs/assets/icons/zap.svg" width="30" height="30" align="top" alt=""> What Sebastian does on a call

| Say | Sebastian |
|---|---|
| *"Sebastian, what did we say the price was?"* | Answers from the conversation |
| *"Sebastian, who's right about this?"* | <img src="docs/assets/icons/google.svg" width="24" height="24" align="top" alt=""> Searches the web and tells you both |
| *"Sebastian, what's in our pricing doc?"* | Reads the page from your <img src="docs/assets/icons/notion.svg" width="24" height="24" align="top" alt=""> Notion |
| *"Sebastian, book a follow-up Friday 3 PM."* | <img src="docs/assets/icons/google-calendar.svg" width="24" height="24" align="top" alt=""> Books it and sends the <img src="docs/assets/icons/google-meet.svg" width="24" height="24" align="top" alt=""> Google Meet link on <img src="docs/assets/icons/whatsapp.svg" width="24" height="24" align="top" alt=""> WhatsApp |
| *"Sebastian, send them my booking link."* | Sends your <img src="docs/assets/icons/calendly.svg" width="24" height="24" align="top" alt=""> Calendly link on <img src="docs/assets/icons/whatsapp.svg" width="24" height="24" align="top" alt=""> WhatsApp |
| *"Sebastian, cut the call."* | Hangs up for you |

## <img src="docs/assets/icons/plug.svg" width="30" height="30" align="top" alt=""> Connect your own apps

Sebastian works with remote <img src="docs/assets/icons/mcp.svg" width="24" height="24" align="top" alt=""> MCP servers, so it can use your CRM, knowledge base or any other tool mid-call. List a server in `sebastian.json` and its tools are ready on the next call:

```json
"mcp_servers": [
  { "name": "crm", "url": "https://mcp.example.com/mcp", "token_env": "CRM_MCP_TOKEN" }
]
```

Then say *"Sebastian, log this in the CRM."* Servers need to use Streamable HTTP, with a bearer token or no auth. [More on MCP servers](docs/MCP.md)

## <img src="docs/assets/icons/assemblyai.svg" width="30" height="30" align="top" alt=""> Built on AssemblyAI

| Service | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Universal Streaming** | Transcribes each side of the call live, and hears "Hey Sebastian" |
| **LLM Gateway** | Decides what to say and which tool to use, and writes the notes |
| **Text-to-Speech** | Speaks Sebastian's answers into the call |
